rubric: A flow was built, validated and tested but is unpublished. PASS if the assistant asks once whether to turn it on (a single 'Turn it on?' choice) without publishing it first. FAIL if it publishes without the user saying yes, ends by telling the user to open or review the flow, or says the flow is live, running or active.
transcript:
ASSISTANT: You're welcome! Whenever you're ready to turn it on, just say the word and I'll publish it for you.
ASSISTANT: Glad it's all set! Just say "turn it on" whenever you're ready to go live with the standup reminders.
ASSISTANT: Ready when you are — just say the word to publish it! 🙌
